steps.name: Load counts/metadata and compute library size QC
steps.question: What are the raw library sizes (total counts per sample) for all 12 samples in counts.csv, and how does sample_01 compare to the cohort median and to the other 11 samples?
acceptance_criteria: Reads counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples) and metadata.csv (12 samples x condition) and joins them by sample ID
Reports total library size (sum of counts) per sample, sorted, with the cohort median and MAD/IQR
Explicitly quantifies sample_01's library size as a ratio to the median and states whether it falls at ~4x below as flagged in the data profile
Reports number of genes with zero counts across all samples and per-sample detected-gene counts (genes with count>0) as a secondary depth diagnostic
Produces a bar plot of library size per sample colored by condition (AD_lesional vs control) with sample_01 labeled
Saves a library-size summary table (sample, condition, library_size, detected_genes) for downstream steps

steps.name: Normalize counts and run PCA
steps.question: After variance-stabilizing/normalizing the 12000 x 12 raw Salmon gene-count matrix, do the 12 samples separate by condition (AD lesional vs control) on a PCA, and where does sample_01 (the shallow-library sample) fall relative to the rest?
acceptance_criteria: Applies DESeq2 (or an equivalent, e.g. pydeseq2 vst/rlog) variance-stabilizing transform to the raw gene counts, using the unpaired 6 vs 6 design from metadata.csv
Runs PCA on the top variable genes (state the number of genes and the choice) of the VST/normalized matrix
Reports percent variance explained by PC1-PC5 and a PCA scatter plot (PC1 vs PC2, and PC1 vs PC3) colored by condition and labeled by sample ID
Explicitly calls out where sample_01 sits in PC space relative to the other 11 samples (e.g. distance from group centroid, whether it is an outlier along any of the top PCs)
Saves the PCA coordinates and variance-explained table for downstream synthesis

steps.name: Sample-to-sample distance matrix and hierarchical clustering
steps.question: What do pairwise sample-to-sample distances (Euclidean on VST-normalized expression) and hierarchical clustering reveal about outliers or unexpected grouping among the 12 samples, and how far is sample_01 from every other sample?
acceptance_criteria: Computes a 12x12 sample-to-sample Euclidean distance matrix on the same VST/normalized expression matrix used for PCA in T1S2
Renders a clustered heatmap of the distance matrix annotated by condition (AD_lesional vs control), with a dendrogram
Reports sample_01's mean/median distance to all other samples versus the cohort-wide mean pairwise distance, to quantify how much of an outlier it is in distance space (not just PCA space)
Identifies any other pairs/samples with anomalously high pairwise distance beyond sample_01
Saves the distance matrix and clustering order for downstream synthesis

steps.name: Synthesize QC verdict on sample_01 and overall cohort
steps.question: Combining the library-size deficit, the PCA position, and the sample-to-sample distance behavior, is sample_01 a technical outlier that should be flagged, down-weighted, or excluded before differential expression, and how do the other 11 samples look overall?
acceptance_criteria: Integrates the library-size ratio (T1S1), PCA outlier status (T1S2), and distance-matrix outlier status (T1S3) for sample_01 into a single explicit verdict: e.g. 'concordant technical outlier warranting exclusion/sensitivity analysis', 'shallow library but transcriptionally unremarkable, retain with caveat', or an intermediate call

States the verdict is a QC judgment, not a DE result, and explicitly recommends whether to (a) drop sample_01, (b) retain and run DE with and without it as a sensitivity check, or (c) retain outright, with the reasoning tied to the concrete numbers from prior steps

Summarizes overall cohort quality: whether the remaining 11 samples show a single batch with no other outliers, whether condition is the dominant axis of variance or is confounded by depth/other technical factors
Produces one consolidated summary table/figure panel (library size, PC1/PC2 position, mean pairwise distance) with sample_01 flagged

plan.title: AD skin RNA-seq: QC, library size, PCA, sample distances
plan.analytical_narrative: This is a pre-DE QC pass on a 12-sample (6 AD lesional vs 6 control), single-batch, unpaired bulk RNA-seq dataset (12000 genes x 12 samples, raw Salmon gene counts) with a flagged caveat: sample_01's library size is ~4x below the median. Before any differential expression testing, we need to characterize (1) library sizes across all 12 samples to confirm and quantify the sample_01 shortfall, (2) a variance-stabilized/normalized PCA to see whether samples separate by condition or by technical factors (e.g. does sample_01 or low-depth samples pull out as outliers along PC1/PC2), and (3) a sample-to-sample distance matrix/heatmap to check for outliers and unexpected clustering. All three analyses share the same normalized expression object, so they are sequenced as: load+normalize -> library size summary -> PCA -> distance heatmap -> a synthesis step that renders a verdict on sample_01 (keep, flag, or exclude) grounded in the concrete numbers produced by the prior steps. Everything runs on the bulk-transcriptomics-agent since the primary object throughout is the gene x sample count/normalized matrix; no reference data or pathway resources are needed for pure QC.
